notes.title: We're making a new game called Cozy Beach!
notes.content:
Very cool news everyone, we are working on a new PC game called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489070/Cozy_Beach/?utm_source=90sSteamUpdate]Cozy Beach[/url]!  It's a game where you can water tube, fish and chill with your friends in a tropical paradise.

There's lot of fun stuff to do there!
🏝 Explore a tropical island solo, co-op or online
😸 Customize an adorable animal avatar and dress them up with lots of stylish options.
🎣 Go fishing and try to collect every fish - some might take a couple players to catch!
🔎 Discover treasure maps and hunt for treasure- what kind of cool stuff will you find?
🍍 Collect fruits, and craft fun and silly tropical drinks from the friendly capybara barkeep - the rarer the ingredients, the more exotic the drink!
⭕  Go water tubing in a lazy river around the beautiful tropical island to take in the sights.
🎶 Jam out to sweet tunes on the radio!
And of course, no day at the beach is complete without hanging out and chatting with your friends 👯‍♂️ 

If this sounds like fun, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489070/Cozy_Beach/?utm_source=90sSteamUpdate]go give it a wishlist today[/url] to join us on the peaceful shores of Cozy Beach! 😸 💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/8bbbe0cd988c21530a45dcb2c601fd18093c5090.png[/img]
Load up the "Arcade Mode" DVD to just jump right to the arcade- no mysteries to worry about, just your skeeball technique and basketball form.
We plan on adding more machines and fun stuff to arcade mode.  We'd love to hear from you if you suggestions!  Check out [url=http://arcade.lunabeat.com]http://arcade.lunabeat.com[/url] to submit suggestions on new arcade games to include!

[url=http://arcade.lunabeat.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/9efe9c0368fcfc9674b9cff8a3d0cffa964a8429.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/dREkEjC3TY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301113/683c33658e553ae869e32c648528af16df8ca236.png[/img][/url]

Finally, Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 90's was invited to be included in the [b]Simfest: Hobby Edition[/b] Steam event happening this week!!  We're super thrilled to have been included in this exclusive event, and we're doing 2 livestreams to celebrate- one on Monday with Laura, one on Tuesday with Scott.  Here are the details!

notes.title: Smooth Locomotion & Turning Added, WMR support & more!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
By very popular demand, we've added [b]smooth locomotion and smooth turning[/b] to the game!

Previously we had teleport-only and snap-only turning, but now you can control your movement settings via the in-game cell phone.

Adjust between teleport and smooth locomotion, set a custom locomotion speed, and set which hand you prefer to move with and which hand to turn with.

For turning, you can select between snap and smooth turning, and also set the angle to which you turn each time.

This was a big request, so we hope you enjoy the new movement features!

We're also looking into a motion smoothing effect option in an upcoming update to make the smooth locomotion more comfortable.  Keep your eyes out for that update next week!

Another big request- we've added in official support for the Windows Mixed Reality (WMR) headset!  We're super pleased to add this headset to our supported devices.  Thanks to the awesome fans who were able to help us test the game!

Finally, we've made a few other changes-
-Made the phone a little bigger, easier to see
-Updated the smartphone instruction poster
-Updated the controller instruction posters
-Updated controller bindings to work with all controller types
-Fixed a teleport bug where the object you're holding would block the teleportation arc
-Claw machine now has a fail-safe in case you can't get the little penguin out- the game will help you now after a certain number of tries.
-Fixed an issue where the skeeballs get caught up in the corner
-Fixed a rare bug that would disable Vive controllers when player paused & unpaused the game.

If you have feedback or suggestions, please let us know here, on the Steam discussion forums, or on our Discord- [url=https://discord.com/invite/dREkEjC3TY]click here to join[/url].

Thanks so much for checking out the update, and we hope you like the new features!
Have a radical weekend!

notes.title: Many updates added this week!
notes.content:
Hey all you radical detectives!
We're rounding up our second week here, and we've been hard at work fixing some bugs that have popped up and working on some suggestions we've had from players!

We're not finished by any means, this is just to catch you up on what we've done so far.  We'll continue to be working in the coming weeks (and months!) on new features that we hope you'll love!

Here's what we tackled this week:

[b]Gameplay Features[/b]
-Changed how some prizes are dropped from the air hockey table- they were getting lost before, now they should be nice and safe.
-Added a puck reset button to the air hockey table in case anything happens to your puck and you can't get it back.
-Any errant skee balls will now return to their origin point when the reset button is pushed.
-Added a note about auto-saving to the start room.
-Recolored a table.  Who says we don't re-decorate??

[b]Audio[/b]
-Changed out Nexus's losing air hockey line
-Nexus will now diss you if you cheat at air hockey
-Arcade music volume control added to cell phone

[b]Bugs Squashed[/b]
-Save game bug impacting the basketball game
-A typo
-Fixed some lighting on some of the arcade objects
-Moved a couple of milk caps that occasionally fall down when the game is loaded
-Cell phone now snaps to an easily accessable position for Vive wand users
-Fixed a condition where Vive wands would grab an object while you were trying to point

We've got a lot updates and feature additions on the way, so stay tuned!

Lastly, if you've picked up the game (thank you!!), [b]will you leave our game a review?[/b]  It really helps us out! <3 Thank you so much!!

Thanks everyone for your support, feedback, plays and reviews!  
We'll be back next week with more cool updates.

Have a great weekend!

notes.title: Post-Launch Update Schedule
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Just wanted to check in with a post-launch update- WOW!!  What a wild and crazy week!! We've been so thrilled to see Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 90's launch, and to see it go well!

We were on top of New and Trending VR, in the Big Adventure Event, got lots of amazing reviews, a week full of streamers, and tons of fun ideas from players to add in.

Thank you so much to everyone who has played the game, reviewed it, streamed it, talked about it, recommended it, gazed lovingly at it, or danced along to the little song at the end.  Thank you so very much!

We patched the game a couple times last week, but there are more updates coming this week.

There's some high-priority issues to tackle right away, mostly the air hockey table losing the puck, and [spoiler]not dropping prize items properly[/spoiler].  We've got a couple other bugs that need a reboot to fix, so we're addressing these first.

After that, we'll do more QOL fixes and updates through the week, and achievements will likely be added soon as well.  We'll also be working on alt movement methods like smooth locomotion and will get you an update on when to expect it soon.

We'll keep you updated here on Steam, Twitter and Discord.
[url=https://discord.gg/dREkEjC3TY]You're invited to join our Discord btw![/url]  Check out our daily dev updates and let us know if you have suggestions or find any bugs.  We love suggestions and hate bugs, so if you have either please join and tell us about them!

We also have Steam Discussion pages to post in, or you can always send us an email mail@lunabeat.com or tweet at us here: https://twitter.com/lunabeatgames

Thank you again for such an amazing launch, we couldn't have done it without all of you!
And keep your eyes out for more updates this week :)

-LunaBeat
